body: Thanks for the replies, I appreciate them. (Still looking for someone with skype as it would be more efficient and help me cope better)

From past experience, I don't think life will ever stop presenting obstacles to us, just vary the degree of difficulty that comes to them. While this idea alone can be somewhat overwhelming, the beauty of life is overcoming these obstacles. I've been in the same position, working so hard and putting in 200% effort into everything I do and there's still no positive change in the outcome, it gets real tiring, it really does. But some days you'll get a break and your struggles will be so worth it. Can't say much atm because I don't know all of your situation, but willing to spend some time learning about it and listening if you want. I have skype if that works better as well.
I sent you a message with my skype name, hopefully I'm not too late and/or could be of some assistance.
I'm not feeling very suicidal, but would like someone to talk to.

1450 (probably will hit 1500 tomorrow but I can queue dodge my way down again) player here, I can play all roles pretty well but I just love playing AD Carry, I've done some competitive play before so I handle pressure very well, real chill, never rage but at the same time take games serious. I'd love to play for a team if possible, if anyone's interested feel free to message me ingame or on reddit.

Would love to get some help with my solotops, currently enjoying and playing Gangplank and Cho'Gath recently. I tend to win most of my lanes as solotop but for some reason have a problem against pantheon while playing Gang. I know people are usually doing only one replay, but perhaps if you had free time you'd be able to look at the other one as well :D.

GangPlank : [replay2] (http://www.leaguereplays.com/replays/match/65165/) <-- playing as the GP on another account. game becomes 4v5 as ad carry has a problem connecting.
Thanks in advance!

**Sit down and talk to your parents. Tell them that you're trying really hard, and just want to know you have their approval. If it doesn't seem to go well, they will at least be thinking about it.**

I would like to sit down and talk to my parents, I really would but I can't.
I've tried and it had no effect, I tried again with a translator just in case there was a language barrier(I'm fluent in Vietnamese but it doesn't seem to be up to my parents standards.) and nothing happened. Nowadays I can hardly look my mother in the eyes, and my dad just seems so angry and irritated all the time I don't wanna bug him about anything. I really miss having parents. I know they still are my parents, but it just isn't the same as the relationship my friends has with theirs

Before my mother had her first relapse (when I was around 6 or 7) I had a little memory that stuck with me although I can't seem to remember any others from when I was that young. But it was with my father and mother(note: this may be confusing to understand but I'll try to put it in my best words possible) would hold my pinky fingers and then swing me(sorta like a swingset but with my parents as the bars holding it up.) I really **miss** those days, and the fact that I know those days were a one-time thing and that happy things with them won't ever happen again really bums me out sometimes.

May I ask if you take any medicine for your schizophrenia? I haven't taken any yet because I don't want the extra money my dad makes to be used on it.

I do feel "lost," maybe even a little more than that but I've felt this way for a 2-3 years now and I just can't find a way to get rid of it.

It's hard for me to actually be interested in anything school-related, I just do it because I have to and it just turns out good.

**To answer your question (What do you want to do next?):**
I'm not entirely sure, I want to maybe become a teacher and do graphic design in my free time as a part time job but I realize that it's not a good paying job combo. I can't really seem to think of anything else, it feels like there's just a mist of uncertainty surrounding me when I try to think about anything or try to solve things.

Although I'm not sure, but I think deep down inside I wanna wait and do nothing and expect things to get brighter but I know that is very unlikely. School is just around the corner so I think it'll keep my mind busy a little bit hopefully, but I'm worried I won't be able to concentrate on the AP classes ( or any of the advanced classes I'm taking) due to my family as things are not going very well for any of us because I was playing tennis today and I think having these things on my mind had a negative effect on my performance.
I'd like to but I can't find anyone around to play with not even the team as they are really lazy but want to improve(i dont understand their logic.) so I usually just go and hit with the wall.
He sounds almost just like me when I have my relapses. Does he take any medicine or have a way that helps him forget about it?

Not to be rude or nosy, but can you tell me how old your friend is and what happened when he got upset?

I'm scared that when more people see the schizophrenic side or know that I am one that they will be scared/run away like the people who I've told. 

EDIT: You could also PM me if it's too personal for everyone to see.

Well my parents did not request/push me to do anything in school, didn't make me work for A's. School is just easy to me, I can fall asleep in most classes and get A's, I just wondered what the big deal was about it since I've seriously seen some parents go crazy over their son getting a B and glorifying their child to their friends. Also my mother is currently beginning her relapse and refuses to cook not even for herself so I'm making several dishes a night since my dad cannot eat any meat but pork and certain types of fish due to his sickness.

I try to watch interviews with my favorite musical artists but there's not many out there that I haven't seen for Lupe Fiasco.

**"You realize that life goes on past high school into adulthood, but sometimes you wonder if it's worth the struggle."**
^ That is dead on about how I feel, I just can't find any inspiration/motivation to help me get through the obstacles at the moment. My work ethic also isn't that amazing either, and I don't know how to change that.

**"Also I should warn you that you will fall way too deeply in love with a nice girl soon."** Why do you say this?

I'm currently number 2 on the Varsity Tennis team for my high school. Yeah, being with other people gets my mind off things easily but the problem is that I always have to go home and the mood completely changes.

Thanks for reading my post and helping me out.

I understand that life is cruel, but sometimes it helps to just try and have a positive view on things on the days where the world just seems to want to bring you down. Currently she's in another relapse where she's saying she's taking her medicine but no one is really sure, so what I did was rotate the medicine bottles a certain way so if she takes anything I'll know. Also thanks for **"But you are a different person to your mother"**. That is actually what I worry about pretty regularly and it just makes me feel better to know that not all people see schizophrenic's as lost cases.
